explication: Clash for Linux is a shell-based Linux platform for managing a Clash/Mihomo proxy runtime. Its principal workflow is to invoke a `clash` command, manage or select a subscription, generate the active runtime configuration, and operate the proxy kernel. The README also documents dashboard access, routing and node selection, TUN, boot takeover, diagnostics, and configuration overlays. The source excerpts were unavailable, so relationships below rely on README statements; paths identify matching files or existing directories in the tree, not inspected implementations.
